name: EPIC 201516805
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 8.6 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201516805 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.5818 (16th-84th percentiles 8.304318-8.922863), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201516805 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.95352 (16th-84th percentiles 0.884353-1.046801), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201516805: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4707.4395 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201516805 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3244.492188 (16th-84th percentiles 3161.171875-3336.71875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,245 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.95 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,707 K at its surface.
